package svcapi_test

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/valueprobe/gen/TRANSPORT/svc/client"
)

func TestValueContract(t *testing.T) {

	raw := "{"
	_, err := client.BuildSendPayload(ARGUMENT)
	if err == nil {

		t.Fatal("malformed input unexpectedly accepted")

	}
	_, example, ok := strings.Cut(err.Error(), "example of valid JSON:\n")
	if !ok {

		t.Fatalf("missing advertised example: %v", err)

	}
	raw = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(example), "'")
	payload, decodeErr := client.BuildSendPayload(ARGUMENT)
	observation := map[string]any{"advertised": raw, "decoded": decodeErr == nil}
	if decodeErr == nil {

		observation["payload"] = payload

	}
	snapshot, err := json.Marshal(observation, json.Deterministic(true))
	if err != nil {

		t.Fatal(err)

	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("observation.json", snapshot, 0600); err != nil {

		t.Fatal(err)

	}
	if decodeErr != nil {

		t.Fatalf("advertised example rejected: %v", decodeErr)

	}
	if expected := EXPECTED; expected != "" {

		data, err := json.Marshal(payload, json.Deterministic(true))
		if err != nil {

			t.Fatal(err)

		}
		var got, want map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &got); err != nil {

			t.Fatal(err)

		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(expected), &want); err != nil {

			t.Fatal(err)

		}
		for field, value := range want {

			actual, err := json.Marshal(got[field], json.Deterministic(true))
			if err != nil {

				t.Fatal(err)

			}
			desired, err := json.Marshal(value, json.Deterministic(true))
			if err != nil {

				t.Fatal(err)

			}
			if string(actual) != string(desired) {

				t.Errorf("authored value replaced at %s: got %s, want %s", field, actual, desired)

			}

		}

	}

}
